name: smart-store
title: Smart Store
description: Find Raycast extensions by describing what you need, read their descriptions in your language, and get a ready-to-use plan to build the ones that don't exist yet.
author: dncwarren

commands.name: search-extensions
commands.title: Search Extensions
commands.subtitle: Smart Store
commands.description: Search the Raycast Store in plain language, with descriptions translated into your language.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Description Language
preferences.description: Language used to display extension descriptions and AI explanations.

preferences.name: aiProvider
preferences.title: AI Provider
preferences.description: Powers plain-language search, translations and extension ideas. Without AI, search falls back to keywords and descriptions are translated with MyMemory.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Only needed for the Anthropic or OpenAI provider.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Optional model override for the Anthropic or OpenAI provider (defaults: claude-opus-5-5, gpt-5-mini).
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty for the default model

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
